hazards.evidence: Standard-height tub wall must be stepped over to reach the shower chair, which sits fully inside the tub; no transfer bench straddles the tub edge. Shoes, clothing and newspapers are also piled on the tub floor/edge at the entry point.
Smooth white fiberglass tub/shower floor with no visible non-slip mat or adhesive treads; surface is slippery when wet.
Regular-height toilet seat with the lid up; no raised/elevated toilet seat is installed (only a stand-alone safety frame), so seat height is likely too low for post hip/knee replacement precautions.
